summary: Chrome Extension v5.1.0 integration testing complete - All 19 tests passed. Backend APIs (auth, candidate-bank, extension capture) validated. Extension files (background.js, popup.js, manifest.json) validated for MV3 compliance, key functions, and critical patterns.

Exponential backoff implemented via Math.pow in requeueWithFailure

context_for_next_testing_agent: Chrome Extension v5.1.0 integration fully tested. Backend APIs working: POST /api/auth/login returns access_token, GET /api/auth/me validates session, POST /api/extension/capture accepts profiles, POST /api/extension/ai-extract works, GET /api/extension/stats returns capture statistics. Extension files validated: background.js has all MV3 fixes (no while-true loop, exponential backoff, _refreshInProgress guard), popup.js has Promise storage helpers and cleanup, manifest.json is valid MV3 with service_worker and proper permissions.

details: POST /api/auth/login returns access_token for extension authentication
GET /api/auth/me validates session and returns user info (used by extension pingSession)
401 returned for invalid/expired tokens (triggers extension silentReLogin)
GET /api/candidate-bank returns candidate list (used for duplicate checking)
Authentication required - returns 401/403 without token
POST /api/extension/capture accepts profile data with CompleteNaukriProfileInput schema
Returns success=true with action (created/updated/exists) and candidate_id
Validates name field - rejects invalid names like 'Search candidates'
Requires authentication
POST /api/extension/ai-extract endpoint exists and responds
Returns profile_data when AI extraction succeeds
Rejects text shorter than 50 characters
GET /api/extension/stats returns total_captured, user_captured, today_captured
background.js: All 8 key functions present (enqueueCapture, drainCaptureQueue, recoverStuckItems, uploadCVBase64, processOfflineQueue, silentReLogin, pingSession)
background.js: NO while(true) loop (MV3 critical fix verified)
background.js: Exponential backoff via Math.pow
background.js: _refreshInProgress guard for concurrent login prevention
manifest.json: Valid MV3 with service_worker (not scripts)
manifest.json: Has alarms, storage, tabs permissions
manifest.json: Host permissions include naukri.com and emergentagent.com
popup.js: Promise-based storageLocalGet/storageSyncGet helpers
popup.js: Window unload cleanup listener for interval and message handler
